verdict.rationale: Semgrep supports writing custom rules that trigger findings on scan events (CI push/PR/MR, pre-commit) and can trigger actions like alerts, ticket creation, and PR/MR comments, which constitutes rule-triggered automation. However, this is event-based scanning automation rather than a general-purpose rule engine for arbitrary AI-native automation workflows. Missing for 10: evidence of a flexible event/webhook system beyond CI/PR/commit hooks, first-party examples of custom multi-step automated actions (beyond alerts/tickets/comments), and independent/hands-on confirmation that these triggers work reliably in practice.
